home_faq_what_q: What is the Tiny Desk AI meme?
home_faq_what_a: It's the trend where AI recasts the Tiny Desk "Outstanding" encore with new faces. {name} lets you choose who takes lead vocals, sax, keys and backup, upload a photo for each, and get the familiar cut back with your cast and the song.
home_faq_people_q: How many people can I put in the video?
home_faq_people_a: Up to five seats: lead vocals, sax, keys and two backup singers. Recast any number of them for the same price. Seats you skip keep the original performer.
home_faq_cost_a: {plans}. One-time payment, no subscription, and credits don't expire.
home_faq_free_q: Can I make one for free?
home_faq_free_a: Not right now. Each video is rendered on a paid AI video model, so we don't offer free renders. If a render fails, the credits go straight back to your account.
home_faq_model_q: Which AI model makes the video?
home_faq_model_a: Kling 4.0 (Kuaishou) in edit mode at {resolution}, rendering the full clip in a single pass.
home_faq_time_a: Typically 7 to 10 minutes. Feel free to close the tab; your video will be on the home page when you sign back in.
home_faq_format_q: How long is the video, and what format?
home_faq_format_a: Around 18 seconds, vertical 9:16 MP4 at {resolution}, no watermark: band shot, the big laugh close-up, sax break, band shot again.
home_faq_song_a: Yes, the original track is in the mix. You also get a muted version: if TikTok or Instagram removes the audio, upload that one and pick "Outstanding" from the in-app sound library.
home_faq_capcut_q: Do I need CapCut, a template or a prompt?
home_faq_capcut_a: No. There's no editor, template file or prompt involved. Pick a seat, upload a photo, render.
home_faq_photo_a: A clear, recent, front-facing photo of one person in decent light with nothing covering the face. Group shots, sunglasses, cartoons and strong filters give weaker results.
home_faq_celebrity_q: Can I put a celebrity, a coach or a player in it?
home_faq_celebrity_a: Yes, public figures and friends both work, as in the trend itself. Keep it clearly a parody: nobody under 18, don't present it as real footage, and don't use it to advertise. If the model rejects a photo, the credits are returned.
home_faq_real_q: Are the viral coach videos real?
home_faq_real_a: No. They are AI edits of Charlie Wilson's 2023 Tiny Desk performance. The coaches and athletes in them never played at NPR.
home_faq_post_q: Can I post it on TikTok or Instagram?
home_faq_post_a: Yes, as personal, non-commercial parody. We can't license the song, so platforms may mute it; the muted copy covers that. Never present it as real or use it in ads.
home_faq_fail_q: What if it fails or doesn't look right?
home_faq_fail_a: Failed renders refund automatically. If a finished video is obviously broken, email us within 7 days and we'll return the credits (see the refund policy). Expect a close likeness, not a perfect clone.
home_faq_photos_a: Your photos are used only to render your video, shared with our AI video provider for that purpose, and removed from our storage within 2 days.
home_faq_npr_q: Is this affiliated with NPR or Tiny Desk?
home_faq_npr_a: No. {name} is an independent meme video tool for parody and commentary. It is not affiliated with, sponsored by, or endorsed by NPR, NPR Music's Tiny Desk Concerts, Charlie Wilson or The Gap Band. Tiny Desk is a trademark of NPR.
